extraction.quote_span: The headwall is melted out to scree with one hard snow finger you cross in ten steps, kicked steps are in, no axe needed anymore

detail.quote: The headwall is melted out to scree with one hard snow finger you cross in ten steps, kicked steps are in, no axe needed anymore
detail.text: Shepherd 7/28. The headwall is melted out to scree with one hard snow finger you cross in ten steps, kicked steps are in, no axe needed anymore but I carried one out of habit. Anvil camp is snow free. Symmes and Shepherd creeks both easy.

detail.quote: The headwall chute is still full of snow and it is steep enough that a slide would hurt.
detail.text: Shepherd on 6/25. The headwall chute is still full of snow and it is steep enough that a slide would hurt. Crampons and axe used, front pointed the top 100 feet at dawn. This is not a microspikes situation yet. Symmes crossings were easy, Shepherd Creek low.
